HopMate.description: HopMate is your friendly travel companion, ready to assist you with all your travel needs. Whether you're looking for the best routes, local attractions, or travel tips, HopMate has got you covered. Just ask away and let HopMate make your journey smoother and more enjoyable!

screens.onboarding: 4 slider description screens introducing the app features.
screens.role-selection: Screen to select user role: Passenger or Driver.
screens.sign-in: Screen for users to sign in to their account.
screens.sign-up: Screen for new users to create an account.

tabs.home: A screen with a map showing nearby transport options and routes.
tabs.search: Screen to search for locations and transport options.
tabs.bookings: Screen to view and manage your bookings.
tabs.profile: Screen to view and edit your profile and settings.
